1. Get the app

\n

Use the current source instructions on\nWindows 10 or 11. A signed installer and package-manager release are still being\nprepared. First-run setup guides you through the choices below.

\n

2. Choose your microphone

\n

On Microphone, keep Default Windows input or choose Refresh inputs to find a\nnamed device. Test input runs a ten-second, level-only check without\ntranscription or saved audio. Check microphone privacy reads Windows permission\nstatus without opening an input. If access is blocked or unknown, follow the\nmicrophone-privacy link to review desktop-app access in Windows settings.

\n

3. Review and install local models

\n

Check this PC gives a provisional capability recommendation. Use speech\nrecommendation selects the suggested speech model; it does not benchmark it,\nenable AI cleanup or download anything.

\n

Review the download size and licenses, then choose Download / Resume.\nProgress shows transfers and checksum verification; Pause is available.\nInstalled packages are checked in the background and reused on later launches.

\n

After installation, Check model performance measures the selected speech model\nwith bundled audio, without a microphone or download. Preparation is separate\nfrom three timed samples. Stop check waits for native work to finish. Unavailable\nAI cleanup speed stays unmeasured, and a fast sample is not an everyday latency\nguarantee. See model choices.

\n

For Thai, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Hindi, Urdu, Indonesian, Malay, Bengali or\nArabic, add the optional shared All languages model. One download serves those\nlanguages; selecting a language starts no transfer. Portuguese, including Brazil,\nis also covered by the default model. See language setup.

\n

Next requires the selected model to be ready. Catalog packages must pass their\nfile checks. An existing local Whisper directory can instead pass an explicit\noffline performance check while its files remain unchanged. Finish checks the\ncurrent model again before saving. Cancelling setup preserves saved preferences;\ndownloaded files remain separate.

\n

4. Choose a shortcut and practice

\n

Existing custom bindings are preserved. A fresh profile uses Ctrl + Win to\ndictate, with F9 as the alternate and Ctrl + Win + Space for hands-free.\nLearn shortcut listens while setup stays focused, for up to ten seconds;\nEscape cancels. Manual entry and conflict checks are also available.

\n

Try it has chat and email fields inside setup. Preparing an installed model opens\nno microphone. Hold your shortcut or choose Record, then release or choose Stop\nand preview. Each practice recording is limited to one minute. Review raw words,\ncleaned text and edit chips. Practice audio stays in memory, creates no History\nentry and uses no external paste or clipboard. You can continue without recording.

\n

If a stop or Settings change ends practice, choose Prepare practice explicitly\nwhen ready. If setup cannot confirm a stop, cancel and restart Saydraft as prompted.

\n

5. Make it sound like you

\n

Style quick pick offers Casual or Formal for Messages and Email. Its rules\npreview uses your last practice transcript or a labelled example. Finish saves\nchanged choices and opens Home after practice stops; existing cleanup intensity\nand AI settings stay unchanged.

\n

Later, use Hub → Style for app-group tones and intensity, Dictionary for names,\nand Snippets for frequently used text. AI cleanup is optional; rules work\nwithout a text model.

\n

6. Try it offline

\n

With compatible speech files installed, open an ordinary text editor and put the\ncursor in an editable field. Hold your shortcut, speak, then release. Disconnect\nWi-Fi and try another sentence. Shift + Alt + Z pastes the last saved dictation.\nReview offline verification\nfor what the check proves and its boundaries.

\n

If something feels wrong

\n

Check that the model is installed and the microphone meter responds. Start in a\nnon-elevated text editor; password and protected fields are excluded. History\nkeeps a saved transcript when an app cannot accept insertion. Continue with\ntroubleshooting and keep private\naudio or text out of public issue reports.

A few useful answers.

Can I continue setup without recording?+

Yes. The practice recording is optional. Installed speech files must still be ready, and Finish rechecks the current model before saving.

Does the practice draft paste into another app?+

No. Practice uses chat and email fields inside setup, keeps its audio in memory and creates no History entry or external clipboard/paste action.

1. Get the app

\n

Use the current source instructions on\nWindows 10 or 11. A signed installer and package-manager release are still being\nprepared. First-run setup guides you through the choices below.

\n

2. Choose your microphone

\n

On Microphone, keep Default Windows input or choose Refresh inputs to find a\nnamed device. Test input runs a ten-second, level-only check without\ntranscription or saved audio. Check microphone privacy reads Windows permission\nstatus without opening an input. If access is blocked or unknown, follow the\nmicrophone-privacy link to review desktop-app access in Windows settings.

\n

3. Review and install local models

\n

Check this PC gives a provisional capability recommendation. Use speech\nrecommendation selects the suggested speech model; it does not benchmark it,\nenable AI cleanup or download anything.

\n

Review the download size and licenses, then choose Download / Resume.\nProgress shows transfers and checksum verification; Pause is available.\nInstalled packages are checked in the background and reused on later launches.

\n

After installation, Check model performance measures the selected speech model\nwith bundled audio, without a microphone or download. Preparation is separate\nfrom three timed samples. Stop check waits for native work to finish. Unavailable\nAI cleanup speed stays unmeasured, and a fast sample is not an everyday latency\nguarantee. See model choices.

\n

For Thai, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Hindi, Urdu, Indonesian, Malay, Bengali or\nArabic, add the optional shared All languages model. One download serves those\nlanguages; selecting a language starts no transfer. Portuguese, including Brazil,\nis also covered by the default model. See language setup.

\n

Next requires the selected model to be ready. Catalog packages must pass their\nfile checks. An existing local Whisper directory can instead pass an explicit\noffline performance check while its files remain unchanged. Finish checks the\ncurrent model again before saving. Cancelling setup preserves saved preferences;\ndownloaded files remain separate.

\n

4. Choose a shortcut and practice

\n

Existing custom bindings are preserved. A fresh profile uses Ctrl + Win to\ndictate, with F9 as the alternate and Ctrl + Win + Space for hands-free.\nLearn shortcut listens while setup stays focused, for up to ten seconds;\nEscape cancels. Manual entry and conflict checks are also available.

\n

Try it has chat and email fields inside setup. Preparing an installed model opens\nno microphone. Hold your shortcut or choose Record, then release or choose Stop\nand preview. Each practice recording is limited to one minute. Review raw words,\ncleaned text and edit chips. Practice audio stays in memory, creates no History\nentry and uses no external paste or clipboard. You can continue without recording.

\n

If a stop or Settings change ends practice, choose Prepare practice explicitly\nwhen ready. If setup cannot confirm a stop, cancel and restart Saydraft as prompted.

\n

5. Make it sound like you

\n

Style quick pick offers Casual or Formal for Messages and Email. Its rules\npreview uses your last practice transcript or a labelled example. Finish saves\nchanged choices and opens Home after practice stops; existing cleanup intensity\nand AI settings stay unchanged.

\n

Later, use Hub → Style for app-group tones and intensity, Dictionary for names,\nand Snippets for frequently used text. AI cleanup is optional; rules work\nwithout a text model.

\n

6. Try it offline

\n

With compatible speech files installed, open an ordinary text editor and put the\ncursor in an editable field. Hold your shortcut, speak, then release. Disconnect\nWi-Fi and try another sentence. Shift + Alt + Z pastes the last saved dictation.\nReview offline verification\nfor what the check proves and its boundaries.

\n

If something feels wrong

\n

Check that the model is installed and the microphone meter responds. Start in a\nnon-elevated text editor; password and protected fields are excluded. History\nkeeps a saved transcript when an app cannot accept insertion. Continue with\ntroubleshooting and keep private\naudio or text out of public issue reports.

On this page

  1. 1. Get the app
  2. 2. Choose your microphone
  3. 3. Review and install local models
  4. 4. Choose a shortcut and practice
  5. 5. Make it sound like you
  6. 6. Try it offline
  7. If something feels wrong

1. Get the app

\n

Use the current source instructions on\nWindows 10 or 11. A signed installer and package-manager release are still being\nprepared. First-run setup guides you through the choices below.

\n

2. Choose your microphone

\n

On Microphone, keep Default Windows input or choose Refresh inputs to find a\nnamed device. Test input runs a ten-second, level-only check without\ntranscription or saved audio. Check microphone privacy reads Windows permission\nstatus without opening an input. If access is blocked or unknown, follow the\nmicrophone-privacy link to review desktop-app access in Windows settings.

\n

3. Review and install local models

\n

Check this PC gives a provisional capability recommendation. Use speech\nrecommendation selects the suggested speech model; it does not benchmark it,\nenable AI cleanup or download anything.

\n

Review the download size and licenses, then choose Download / Resume.\nProgress shows transfers and checksum verification; Pause is available.\nInstalled packages are checked in the background and reused on later launches.

\n

After installation, Check model performance measures the selected speech model\nwith bundled audio, without a microphone or download. Preparation is separate\nfrom three timed samples. Stop check waits for native work to finish. Unavailable\nAI cleanup speed stays unmeasured, and a fast sample is not an everyday latency\nguarantee. See model choices.

\n

For Thai, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Hindi, Urdu, Indonesian, Malay, Bengali or\nArabic, add the optional shared All languages model. One download serves those\nlanguages; selecting a language starts no transfer. Portuguese, including Brazil,\nis also covered by the default model. See language setup.

\n

Next requires the selected model to be ready. Catalog packages must pass their\nfile checks. An existing local Whisper directory can instead pass an explicit\noffline performance check while its files remain unchanged. Finish checks the\ncurrent model again before saving. Cancelling setup preserves saved preferences;\ndownloaded files remain separate.

\n

4. Choose a shortcut and practice

\n

Existing custom bindings are preserved. A fresh profile uses Ctrl + Win to\ndictate, with F9 as the alternate and Ctrl + Win + Space for hands-free.\nLearn shortcut listens while setup stays focused, for up to ten seconds;\nEscape cancels. Manual entry and conflict checks are also available.

\n

Try it has chat and email fields inside setup. Preparing an installed model opens\nno microphone. Hold your shortcut or choose Record, then release or choose Stop\nand preview. Each practice recording is limited to one minute. Review raw words,\ncleaned text and edit chips. Practice audio stays in memory, creates no History\nentry and uses no external paste or clipboard. You can continue without recording.

\n

If a stop or Settings change ends practice, choose Prepare practice explicitly\nwhen ready. If setup cannot confirm a stop, cancel and restart Saydraft as prompted.

\n

5. Make it sound like you

\n

Style quick pick offers Casual or Formal for Messages and Email. Its rules\npreview uses your last practice transcript or a labelled example. Finish saves\nchanged choices and opens Home after practice stops; existing cleanup intensity\nand AI settings stay unchanged.

\n

Later, use Hub → Style for app-group tones and intensity, Dictionary for names,\nand Snippets for frequently used text. AI cleanup is optional; rules work\nwithout a text model.

\n

6. Try it offline

\n

With compatible speech files installed, open an ordinary text editor and put the\ncursor in an editable field. Hold your shortcut, speak, then release. Disconnect\nWi-Fi and try another sentence. Shift + Alt + Z pastes the last saved dictation.\nReview offline verification\nfor what the check proves and its boundaries.

\n

If something feels wrong

\n

Check that the model is installed and the microphone meter responds. Start in a\nnon-elevated text editor; password and protected fields are excluded. History\nkeeps a saved transcript when an app cannot accept insertion. Continue with\ntroubleshooting and keep private\naudio or text out of public issue reports.

A few useful answers.

Can I continue setup without recording?+

Yes. The practice recording is optional. Installed speech files must still be ready, and Finish rechecks the current model before saving.

Does the practice draft paste into another app?+

No. Practice uses chat and email fields inside setup, keeps its audio in memory and creates no History entry or external clipboard/paste action.

1. Get the app

\n

Use the current source instructions on\nWindows 10 or 11. A signed installer and package-manager release are still being\nprepared. First-run setup guides you through the choices below.

\n

2. Choose your microphone

\n

On Microphone, keep Default Windows input or choose Refresh inputs to find a\nnamed device. Test input runs a ten-second, level-only check without\ntranscription or saved audio. Check microphone privacy reads Windows permission\nstatus without opening an input. If access is blocked or unknown, follow the\nmicrophone-privacy link to review desktop-app access in Windows settings.

\n

3. Review and install local models

\n

Check this PC gives a provisional capability recommendation. Use speech\nrecommendation selects the suggested speech model; it does not benchmark it,\nenable AI cleanup or download anything.

\n

Review the download size and licenses, then choose Download / Resume.\nProgress shows transfers and checksum verification; Pause is available.\nInstalled packages are checked in the background and reused on later launches.

\n

After installation, Check model performance measures the selected speech model\nwith bundled audio, without a microphone or download. Preparation is separate\nfrom three timed samples. Stop check waits for native work to finish. Unavailable\nAI cleanup speed stays unmeasured, and a fast sample is not an everyday latency\nguarantee. See model choices.

\n

For Thai, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Hindi, Urdu, Indonesian, Malay, Bengali or\nArabic, add the optional shared All languages model. One download serves those\nlanguages; selecting a language starts no transfer. Portuguese, including Brazil,\nis also covered by the default model. See language setup.

\n

Next requires the selected model to be ready. Catalog packages must pass their\nfile checks. An existing local Whisper directory can instead pass an explicit\noffline performance check while its files remain unchanged. Finish checks the\ncurrent model again before saving. Cancelling setup preserves saved preferences;\ndownloaded files remain separate.

\n

4. Choose a shortcut and practice

\n

Existing custom bindings are preserved. A fresh profile uses Ctrl + Win to\ndictate, with F9 as the alternate and Ctrl + Win + Space for hands-free.\nLearn shortcut listens while setup stays focused, for up to ten seconds;\nEscape cancels. Manual entry and conflict checks are also available.

\n

Try it has chat and email fields inside setup. Preparing an installed model opens\nno microphone. Hold your shortcut or choose Record, then release or choose Stop\nand preview. Each practice recording is limited to one minute. Review raw words,\ncleaned text and edit chips. Practice audio stays in memory, creates no History\nentry and uses no external paste or clipboard. You can continue without recording.

\n

If a stop or Settings change ends practice, choose Prepare practice explicitly\nwhen ready. If setup cannot confirm a stop, cancel and restart Saydraft as prompted.

\n

5. Make it sound like you

\n

Style quick pick offers Casual or Formal for Messages and Email. Its rules\npreview uses your last practice transcript or a labelled example. Finish saves\nchanged choices and opens Home after practice stops; existing cleanup intensity\nand AI settings stay unchanged.

\n

Later, use Hub → Style for app-group tones and intensity, Dictionary for names,\nand Snippets for frequently used text. AI cleanup is optional; rules work\nwithout a text model.

\n

6. Try it offline

\n

With compatible speech files installed, open an ordinary text editor and put the\ncursor in an editable field. Hold your shortcut, speak, then release. Disconnect\nWi-Fi and try another sentence. Shift + Alt + Z pastes the last saved dictation.\nReview offline verification\nfor what the check proves and its boundaries.

\n

If something feels wrong

\n

Check that the model is installed and the microphone meter responds. Start in a\nnon-elevated text editor; password and protected fields are excluded. History\nkeeps a saved transcript when an app cannot accept insertion. Continue with\ntroubleshooting and keep private\naudio or text out of public issue reports.

A few useful answers.

Can I continue setup without recording?+

Yes. The practice recording is optional. Installed speech files must still be ready, and Finish rechecks the current model before saving.

Does the practice draft paste into another app?+

No. Practice uses chat and email fields inside setup, keeps its audio in memory and creates no History entry or external clipboard/paste action.
